tools.name: compare_prices
tools.description: Price comparison for one part: every merchant offer (price, stock, link), lowest and highest price. This site is a comparator: it does not sell parts itself.

url.description: Or the part's page URL on this site.

lang.description: Site language for labels and URLs (defaults to the current page's language).

tools.name: find_parts_for_vehicle
tools.description: Lists catalog parts compatible with a vehicle. Ids come from list_vehicle_options; the more levels given (brand, family, model, engine), the more precise the result.

page.description: Results page (50 parts per page); see `has_more`.

lang.description: Site language for labels and URLs (defaults to the current page's language).

tools.name: list_vehicle_options
tools.description: Walks the vehicle selector one level at a time: brand -> family -> model -> engine. Call with no vehicle fields to get the brands, then pass the chosen ids back to get the next level's options. `next_level` tells which level to choose next (null once the engine is chosen).

lang.description: Site language for labels and URLs (defaults to the current page's language).

tools.name: search_parts
tools.description: Full-text search of the auto-parts catalog (part name, OEM/manufacturer reference, EAN, brand). Returns the best matching parts, plus matching categories and part brands.

query.description: Search terms, e.g. 'plaquette de frein clio 3' or a part reference.

lang.description: Site language for labels and URLs (defaults to the current page's language).
